intended_object: A helper that builds a configuration (state label, local variables and ten stacks) of the library's internal `delimitedPairComparisonMachine`, a TM2 machine. It is used in the proofs of the GapCVP reduction. The docstring only says "GapCVP reduction support."
explanation: This is not a mathematical object, so there is nothing to compare it against. The definition only packages data: it builds a configuration of one specific Turing machine (`delimitedPairComparisonMachine`) defined inside the library. It sets the phase label, sets the variables to `none, none, outcome`, and fills the ten stacks from the given lists. It is an implementation detail used to state and prove how that machine runs during the GapCVP reduction. No standard notion in the literature corresponds to it.
